reports.title: Legend Biotech Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Recent Highlights

desk.headline: Revenue up 32% to $359.5m, in line; swings to $51.7m profit on CARVYKTI sales up 36%; no guidance in release

other.label: CARVYKTI net trade sales (total, incl. J&J share)

results: Total revenue rose 32% to $359.5m; collaboration revenue (Legend's share of CARVYKTI) rose to $353.2m from $261.8m.
CARVYKTI sales across the J&J partnership reached about $710m, up 36%: US +19%, outside the US +86%. It is now offered at 373 sites in 20 markets.
Net profit was $51.7m (13c a share) against a $39.6m loss; adjusted net income was $55.6m (14c).
R&D fell 16% to $95.3m as big CARVYKTI trials wound down; admin costs fell to $14.8m, helped by a reversal of share-based pay on forfeited awards.
Operating cash flow was a $35.9m outflow in the quarter; cash and time deposits were about $853m.

guidance.summary: The press release gives no revenue or profit outlook. We could not verify any outlook from the call.

watch: Whether CARVYKTI US growth (19%) picks up as updated NCCN guidelines steer earlier-line patients to CAR-T.
Start of the US Phase 1/2 trial of LB2501, the in vivo CAR-T cleared by the FDA.
First full quarter under new CEO Ingrid Zhang (appointed 15 Sep 2026).
